description.ja: 新世代の「武者頑駄無」が輝羅鋼を携え堂々参戦！
description.en: A new generation of "Musha Gundam" proudly enters the battle with Kirakko!

description.ja: ■輝羅鋼とは、射出成形とフィルムの貼り付けを同時に行うインモールド成形技術の応用。
description.en: • Kirakko is an application of in-mold molding technology that performs injection molding and film attachment at the same time.

description.ja: ■クリアパーツの「抜け感」と輝羅鋼の「彩色造形」が生み出すコントラストにご注目。
description.en: • Pay attention to the contrast created by the clear parts' loose feel and the colored molding of Kira Steel.

description.ja: ■刀にも輝羅鋼を採用。肘の可動範囲により抜刀の構えを再現可能。
description.en: • The sword also uses Kira steel. The stance of drawing a sword can be reproduced by the range of motion of the elbow.

description.ja: ■別売りの「SDW HEROES 隠密ガンダムエアリアル」に付属のパーツと連動。
description.en: • Interlocks with the parts included in the separately sold "SDW HEROES Covert Gundam Aerial".
